react-doctor.description: Run React Doctor analysis (lint, dead code, a11y, bundle, architecture)
react-doctor.template: Run react-doctor on this project: execute `npx -y react-doctor@latest . --verbose` and report the health score (0-100). List any critical issues found — especially security, performance, and correctness problems. If this is after code changes, use `--diff` flag instead to check for regressions.
